items.title: Here’s How To Catch The CTA’s Holiday Train And Bus Starting Next Week
items.description: Find the holiday bus starting Nov. 24 and the holiday train starting Nov. 27, with festive decorations and greetings from Santa.

items.title: Pilsen Group Inviting Businesses To Light Up 18th Street To Honor Late Community Leader
items.description: The United Merchants of Pilsen Chamber of Commerce will decorate trees along the corridor for the holidays in memory of beloved sewing shop owner Rigoberto Gonzalez, who died late last year.

items.title: Tired Of Her Kids’ Socks Going Missing, Beverly Mom Creates ‘Linked Soles’ That Snap Together
items.description: Linked Soles, which start shipping next month, can be attached using snaps. They're available for toddlers up to 12-year-olds.

items.title: Friends Of Tony Fitzpatrick Organize Tribute To Late Artist’s Musical Talents
items.description: Fitzpatrick’s lesser-known musical works will be performed Wednesday and Thursday at Constellation by Jon Langford, Rick Kogan, Kelly Hogan and others.

items.title: Chicago Public Schools Overtime Spending Surged To $150 Million. Watchdog Flags Oversight Gaps
items.description: A report from the district’s Office of the Inspector General is urging CPS to improve how it monitors extra pay spending, which remains well above pre-COVID levels.

items.title: Inaugural ‘Pavo Pacers’ Run Brings Puerto Rican Tradition To Humboldt Park This Weekend
items.description: Organizers hope the event, which raises money for elders in Puerto Rico in need of food and other necessities, will become a tradition.

items.title: West Ridge Nature Park Opens Learning Lodge: ‘You Have To Teach Kids To Love Nature’
items.description: The lodge, which is used for field trips and other educational events, was installed this fall. The park advisory council is looking for volunteers to help with programs.

items.title: Proximo Padel Expands To Goose Island As Owners Seek To Introduce More Chicagoans To Growing Sport
items.description: The racket sport is having a moment in Chicago as courts continue to spring up across the city. Proximo's new location will also feature a cafe and bar.
